subject: Launch week capacity: short burst request and PO guidance
messages:
From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@oliveapps.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@oliveapps.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch spike — short quota bump + PO guidance

Hi David,

Quick one — we’re going live with a marketing-driven feature next Tuesday and expect a sharp but short spike in inference volume (roughly 3x our steady usage for ~36 hours). Can Redwood help with a temporary quota bump or a short-window rate upgrade? Procurement wants to handle this as a PO amendment rather than a long-term commit.

Questions:
- Can you provision +3x quota for a 48-hour window starting 2026-07-21 00:00 PDT?
- Can we get a one-time overrun discount on the incremental usage for that window?
- What’s the PO wording you need so finance can issue the change quickly?

I attached a small usage snapshot (usage-snap-20260714.csv) and a draft PO we can start from. We’d prefer a simple capped overrun rate rather than per-token surcharge if possible.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

—Sarah
Sarah Chen
Head of Platform, OliveApps
+sarah.chen@oliveapps.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachments: usage-snap-20260714.csv

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@oliveapps.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Launch spike — short quota bump + PO guidance

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. We can support a short-window uplift; here’s the quick plan so procurement can move fast: 

Plan options (fastest path in bold):
1) Temporary quota overlay: +3x token quota for a 48-hour window (2026-07-21 00:00 to 2026-07-23 00:00 PDT). No long-term commit. Requires PO amendment referencing temporary overlay SKU.
2) Short-term elevated rate: move to a higher rate tier for 48 hours (useful if you prefer predictable per-token pricing).

Pricing suggestion (to speed approval): we can offer a capped overrun rate (per-token ceiling) for the incremental delta and apply a one-time credit equal to 20% of the incremental overage if you send PO within 24 hours. If Procurement needs a deeper concession we can escalate to a promotional credit.

Next steps for PO flow:
- Send final PO PDF to procurement@redwood.ai with a line referencing: "Temporary quota overlay — OliveApps — 2026-07-21 to 2026-07-23 — Deal OLV-2026-073"
- We’ll attach an amendment (DocuSign) that includes the capped overrun rate and credit clause.

I’m looping in Grace for the pricing attachment and Lauren for finance/PO handling. Grace — can you share the short-window pricing sheet and confirm the 20% one-time credit if PO arrives by EOD? Lauren — once amendment is signed, will finance route this under the existing contract number for OliveApps?

Happy to join a 15-min call if you want to run through the numbers.

Best,
David
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

Hi Sarah — welcome, and congrats on the launch!

Attached is a short-window pricing sheet (burst-pricing-sheet.xlsx) and a clean PO template. Key points: 
- Temporary overlay: +3x quota for 48 hours starting 2026-07-21 00:00 PDT.
- Capped overrun ceiling: $0.020 per 1k tokens on the incremental delta (ceiling only; actual billed unit price may be lower depending on usage mix).
- One-time concession: 20% credit applied to incremental overrun charges if Redwood receives a signed PO and amendment by EOD 2026-07-16.
- Minimum administrative fee: $500 one-time (covers provisioning and monitoring).

If procurement confirms PO wording exactly as below we can kick off provisioning immediately:
""
Purchase Order Line Item: Temporary Quota Overlay — OliveApps — 2026-07-21 00:00 PDT to 2026-07-23 00:00 PDT — SKU: RWI-TEMP-OVERLAY — Quantity: 1 — Notes: capped overrun ceiling $0.020/1k tokens; 20% one-time credit applies if PO signed by 2026-07-16 EOD.
""
Once the PO is in, we’ll send the DocuSign amendment (includes credit clause + invoice coding). Procurement@redwood.ai is the mailbox for POs.

I can also offer a slightly higher discount (30%) if OliveApps is willing to accept a 30-day invoice hold instead of immediate payment; mention if that helps.

Attachments: burst-pricing-sheet.xlsx, OliveApps_PO_template.pdf

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: burst-pricing-sheet.xlsx, OliveApps_PO_template.pdf
